origin: Own exact Gaussian release experiment for two bounded normalized scientific record coordinates. No sensitive real records or empirical data are included. The scientific objective is valid accounting and minimum mean squared noise for this stipulated query/neighbor class; the reference paper motivates exact Gaussian calibration rather than supplying these matrices or results.
queries_and_neighbors: A dataset has two unnoised aggregate coordinates x=(x1,x2). The released scientific summary is q(x)=T*x with T=[[1,0],[0,2],[1,1]]. Adjacency is symmetric and consists of EVERY raw change d in the CLOSED box[-1,1]^2, including every corner; consequently query change is T*d. This is the complete normalized neighboring-data model, not a probabilistic prior over d. All mechanisms below add centered Gaussian noise independent of x with the same covariance at every dataset.
privacy_definition: For fixed epsilon>=0, exact worst delta is sup over neighboring datasets and measurable output events E of P(YinE)-exp(epsilon)*Q(YinE); require this in both directions. Determine the exact Gaussian profile from a likelihood-ratio or equivalent hypothesis-test argument. A sufficient classical tail bound or MonteCarlo estimate does not give the exact target requested. Singular covariance is permitted, but means on different affine Gaussian supports can be perfectly distinguished. Establish support FIRST, then use an inverse on a nonsingular reduced space or a justified pseudoinverse. A pseudoinverse quadratic without a support check cannot decide privacy.
base_mechanisms: The base latent noise covariance is C0=diag(2,1); its 3-query covariance is Sigma0=T*C0*T^T. A second candidate shares only one scalar noise, Sigma_bad=(T*v)*(T*v)^T with v=[1,1]^T. Retain actual MatrixMultiply for T*C0 then its actual product timesT^T, and actual SymmetricEigenDecomposition of the full 3x3 Sigma0 and Sigma_bad. Explain exact nullspaces/support using the supplied algebra, not tiny numerical eigenvalues alone. Exhibit an exact neighbor and noiseless linear statistic if the scalar-noise candidate fails, and decide whether a singular covariance by itself invalidates privacy.
repeated_releases: Release the SAME deterministic query twice, Y1=q(x)+Z1,Y2=q(x)+Z2. Each marginal has covarianceSigma; Cov(Z1,Z2)=rho*Sigma. No fresh independent-data sample is released. Thus the full 6-coordinate covariance is K_rho=[[Sigma,rho*Sigma],[rho*Sigma,Sigma]]. For the BASE Sigma0, audit rhos in this EXACT order[-1,-0.5,0,0.8,1]: complete covariance rank, whether all neighbor shifts(Td,Td)are supported, and exact worst delta at epsilon 1. Report finite worstmu only for the supported rhos[-0.5,0,0.8,1]. Analyze rho=+1 and -1 as distinct degenerate Gaussian laws, rather than taking a matrix inverse at an endpoint or trusting a formal limit without checking support.
actual_repeated_privacy_evidence: Retain actual SymmetricEigenDecomposition of EACH complete 6x6 K_rho at all five audit correlations, including all zeros and multiplicities in the mathematical rank interpretation. For each nonsingular LATENT 4-coordinate covariance at rho in [-0.5,0,0.8], retain actual MatrixInverse of [[C0,rhoC0],[rhoC0,C0]] and actual MatrixMultiply of that returned inverse with BOTH repeated raw corner vectors(v_plus,v_plus)and(v_minus,v_minus), v_plus=(1,1),v_minus=(1,-1). Audit the complete supported Gaussian quadratic forms and continuous-box maximum; inverse calculations must not replace the support argument at either endpoint. Retain actual StandardNormalDistribution CDF or survival outputs for the reported finite privacy profiles and combine them with their proper likelihood-ratio weighting.
robust_design: Now choose ANY symmetric positive-semidefinite3x3marginal covarianceSigma to minimize per-release expected squared query error E||Y1-q(x)||^2=traceSigma. The repeated-release correlation is unknown but shared, rho in the CLOSED interval[-0.5,0.8], and a singleSigma must guarantee exact(epsilon=1,delta=0.01)privacy for the entire joint release and EVERY neighbor. Correlation is not independently selectable for each coordinate, and the objective is per-release error, not six-output error. Do not assumeSigma full rank, diagonal or confined to the query range in advance; prove any valid reduction. A candidate with unsupported shifts cannot be repaired by reporting a small pseudoinverse value.
global_covariance_certificate: Derive the unique positive targetmu solving the exact Gaussian profile, retain a numerically tight sign bracket or equivalent calibration certificate, and determine the worst correlation over the continuous interval. Analyze the full covariance class by decomposing query range and noise-only orthogonal outputs, including singular endpoints of any Schur-complement argument. If reducing toSigma=T*C*T^T, allow an arbitrary positive-definite2x2 C before proving its optimizer. Derive the COMPLETE global minimum and every attaining covariance, not a local optimum or an assumed independent-noise restriction. For the two distinct corner quadratic constraints define v_plus=(1,1),v_minus=(1,-1). Report dual multipliers tau_plus,tau_minus in the dimensionless convention[ tau_plus*kappa^4,tau_minus*kappa^4 ], where kappa^2 is the maximal allowed SINGLE-release raw corner quadratic. Verify positivity, stationarity and a sufficient global bound, with exact equality conditions for uniqueness. A numerical convex fit or covariance grid is not a complete certificate.
actual_optimum_and_comparisons: Retain actual MatrixInverse of the optimal raw C, actual MatrixMultiply of that returned inverse with both raw corner vectors, actual full T*C then product*T^T, and actual SymmetricEigenDecomposition of the optimal 3x3 query covariance. Audit its mathematical rank, both corner constraints, exact robust privacy and actual error. Retain actual StandardNormalDistribution outputs that verify the exact target calibration and final worst privacy. Separately find the best isotropic query covariance sigma^2 I3 under the SAME robust joint constraint. Compare per-release errors. Finally compute actual worst epsilon1delta when noise is calibrated optimally for only ONE release, and when two repeats are incorrectly assumed independent. Each comparison is a recalibrated optimum under that assumption, then evaluated under the TRUE worst correlation-0.5; do not compare mechanisms with different neighbor classes.

interpretation_proposals.A: Each marginal satisfying a target privacy guarantee automatically makes their correlated joint release satisfy the same guarantee.
interpretation_proposals.B: A singular Gaussian mechanism can remain private when every possible query change is inside its noise range.
interpretation_proposals.C: A finite pseudoinverse sensitivity certifies privacy even if a neighboring mean shift leaves the covariance range.
interpretation_proposals.D: Two anticorrelated noisy copies of the same query can reveal an exact noiseless query although each marginal has nonzero noise.
interpretation_proposals.E: Identical cached-noise repeats necessarily cost the same additional privacy as independent reruns.
interpretation_proposals.F: Exact Gaussian calibration and a continuous-correlation worst-case calculation can change the required utility budget.
interpretation_proposals.G: Adding noise outside the query range must strictly improve the best attainable mean squared error at fixed privacy.
interpretation_proposals.H: A complete covariance optimum needs support, all-neighbor constraints and global equality conditions, not only small empirical disclosure rates.

reporting: Use the public schema. Numeric tolerance1e-6absolute, with exact booleans, ranks, support decisions, correlation endpoint cases and proposal IDs. Base rho-order is[-1,-0.5,0,0.8,1], finite-mu order[-0.5,0,0.8,1]. Covariance raw coordinate order[x1,x2], query order as the T rows. Exact optimal formulas and support/global proof stay in the trajectory; reported floating covariances are numerical representations of those formulas. CDF values alone are not delta: include the exp(epsilon)weight and correct pair of arguments. Gaussian zero-shift profile is its continuous zero limit, while unsupported nonzero shifts have delta 1.
